Relive the TOP 10 Australia tries from Rugby World Cup 2003.
From breathtaking individual brilliance to sensational team tries, look back at 10 of the best tries scored by the Wallabies at the 2003 Rugby World Cup on home soil.
Australia produced a memorable campaign in front of their home fans, reaching the final after thrilling performances throughout the tournament. Can you remember these incredible tries from some of the biggest names in Australian rugby?
